behaviours: the root layout mounts the toaster (without a container no toast can be seen anywhere)
the toaster is at the top centre of the screen
the toaster is a client component
a sticky toast has no timer and a close button
a finished circular upload shows the sticky toast
the toast is shown after the upload response (the circular is saved), not before
a published announcement shows the sticky toast
an updated announcement shows the sticky toast
a deleted circular shows the sticky toast (not the 2-second one)
a failed delete is still an error toast
Tailwind scans src/lib/ui (the sticky toast's classes, e.g. -mr-3, exist only there: without it the cross is drawn unstyled / in the wrong place)
Tailwind scans every folder under src/lib whose files carry classes
the toasts are shown only on success (an error never says ✅)
